-- ofertas por estado
SELECT status, count(*) FROM offers WHERE request_id = '2715b3f9-5a70-4872-b2c2-f14e272022ab' GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

-- eventos TripAssigned
SELECT count(*) FROM outbox WHERE type = 'TripAssigned' AND payload->>'solicitudId' = '2715b3f9-5a70-4872-b2c2-f14e272022ab'

-- la solicitud después de cancelar
